ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #14
====

GRADE: Grade 9
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   B. Refusing to help a neighbour
   C. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   D. Skipping all moral lessons

2. Which response best shows understanding of Belief in the Last Day Hellfire? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Belief in the Last Day Hellfire with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Belief in the Last Day Hellfire has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Belief in the Last Day Hellfire.
   D. Use Belief in the Last Day Hellfire to insult classmates of other faiths.

3. Which response best shows understanding of Selected Chapter Surah al- Hujurat? (1 mark)
   A. Say Selected Chapter Surah al- Hujurat has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Selected Chapter Surah al- Hujurat.
   C. Use Selected Chapter Surah al- Hujurat to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Selected Chapter Surah al- Hujurat with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

4. Which response best shows understanding of Prohibitions in Islam Zina? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Prohibitions in Islam Zina with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Prohibitions in Islam Zina has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Prohibitions in Islam Zina.
   D. Use Prohibitions in Islam Zina to insult classmates of other faiths.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Domestic violence 06 6.2 Iddah 05 6.3 Child custody 04 6.4 Polygamy in Islam 06 ? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Domestic violence 06 6.2 Iddah 05 6.3 Child custody 04 6.4 Polygamy in Islam 06 .
   B. Say Domestic violence 06 6.2 Iddah 05 6.3 Child custody 04 6.4 Polygamy in Islam 06  has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Domestic violence 06 6.2 Iddah 05 6.3 Child custody 04 6.4 Polygamy in Islam 06  to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Domestic violence 06 6.2 Iddah 05 6.3 Child custody 04 6.4 Polygamy in Islam 06  with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

6. Which response best shows understanding of Shariah religion intellect life property dignity? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Shariah religion intellect life property dignity with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Shariah religion intellect life property dignity to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Shariah religion intellect life property dignity has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Shariah religion intellect life property dignity.

7. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   B. Waste food daily
   C. Pollute rivers deliberately
   D. Destroy trees without planting

8. Which response best shows understanding of Virtues in Islam? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Virtues in Islam with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Virtues in Islam has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Virtues in Islam.
   D. Use Virtues in Islam to insult classmates of other faiths.

9. Which response best shows understanding of Ulum al- Qur’an miraculous nature of the Qur’an the Qur’an Qur’an? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Ulum al- Qur’an miraculous nature of the Qur’an the Qur’an Qur’an with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Ulum al- Qur’an miraculous nature of the Qur’an the Qur’an Qur’an.
   C. Use Ulum al- Qur’an miraculous nature of the Qur’an the Qur’an Qur’an to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Ulum al- Qur’an miraculous nature of the Qur’an the Qur’an Qur’an has no place in daily life.

10. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Hiding stolen items
   B. Cheating in exams
   C. Spreading rumours
   D. Telling the truth and keeping trust

11. Which response best shows understanding of Selected Hadith Unity Avoidance of ill motives? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Selected Hadith Unity Avoidance of ill motives with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Selected Hadith Unity Avoidance of ill motives.
   C. Say Selected Hadith Unity Avoidance of ill motives has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Selected Hadith Unity Avoidance of ill motives to insult classmates of other faiths.

12. Which response best shows understanding of Ulum al-Hadith Hadith compilation of Hadith? (1 mark)
   A. Say Ulum al-Hadith Hadith compilation of Hadith has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Ulum al-Hadith Hadith compilation of Hadith with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Ulum al-Hadith Hadith compilation of Hadith.
   D. Use Ulum al-Hadith Hadith compilation of Hadith to insult classmates of other faiths.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Tawbah and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Virtues in Islam and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Significance of Islamic Morality and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Prohibitions in Islam Zina and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

MARKING SCHEME
====

1. A — Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

2. A — Apply the teaching of Belief in the Last Day Hellfire with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

3. D — Apply the teaching of Selected Chapter Surah al- Hujurat with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

4. A — Apply the teaching of Prohibitions in Islam Zina with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

5. D — Apply the teaching of Domestic violence 06 6.2 Iddah 05 6.3 Child custody 04 6.4 Polygamy in Islam 06  with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

6. A — Apply the teaching of Shariah religion intellect life property dignity with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

7. A — Care for the environment and use resources wisely

8. A — Apply the teaching of Virtues in Islam with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

9. A — Apply the teaching of Ulum al- Qur’an miraculous nature of the Qur’an the Qur’an Qur’an with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

10. D — Telling the truth and keeping trust

11. A — Apply the teaching of Selected Hadith Unity Avoidance of ill motives with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

12. B — Apply the teaching of Ulum al-Hadith Hadith compilation of Hadith with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

13. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Tawbah; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

14. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Virtues in Islam; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Significance of Islamic Morality; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Prohibitions in Islam Zina; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
